name: Seo Hyesung
source:
The youngest contestant who has bright and mischievous personality. Although he always received low scores from the judges, by using his popularity through social media he has garnered a large number from viewer votes. During the finals it was revealed through social media that he was a bully at school, causing his votes to drop dramatically.

Mid-season voting results: 5th place.

[Edited from English Official website]
